messages:
sam_sales: Heads up 1: Enterprise legal wants explicit domain verification steps and a SCIM SLA note. Also concerned about RBAC mapping leaking access across subdomains.

nina_eng: We offer two domain-claim flows: DNS TXT `_redwood-claim.<domain>` and SAML-backed claim via signed assertion with `domain` attribute. DNS example: `_redwood-claim.acme.com TXT "rw=9f3a"`.

omar_security: Need to confirm: SCIM TLS enforced, at-rest encryption via customer KMS or our KMS, immutable admin audit logs, and ability to limit provisioning by domain list.

claire_prod: On RBAC: we support mapping IdP groups -> roles and per-tenant toggles to disable auto-provision-from-groups. We can also whitelist allowed email domains in console.

nina_eng: SCIM scoping sample: GET /Users?filter=emails.value co "@acme.com" and server-side enforced scopes to reject non-matching emails on POST. We'll provide a dry-run option for initial imports.

sam_sales: Pricing: if they want Dedicated, are there setup fees and does heavy SCIM churn affect costs?

infra-bot: billing-bot: Dedicated includes a one-time provisioning fee + monthly reserved capacity. SCIM traffic is included; very high churn may require higher reserved throughput tier (pricing addendum).

omar_security: Also ask for retention window requirements (default 365 days). If they need longer retention for audit, we can add enterprise add-on.

claire_prod: Action items: Nina to draft DNS TXT sample + SAML metadata checklist; Omar to confirm retention + KMS options; Infra-bot/Finance to provide ballpark Dedicated onboarding fee. Deadline: Thurs EOD.

sam_sales: Perfect. I'll send the customer the checklist and schedule the demo once we have the numbers.
